name: dsh-plugin-task-bridge
description: Loopback HTTP control-plane bridge for DeepSeek Harness: lets an external local supervisor process (e.g. a Codex CLI/MCP driver) spawn, message, inspect and wait on DSH task sessions through six token-guarded exact routes registered on the host webserver. /v1/spawn accepts an optional externalRef (free-form external caller reference, <=200 chars after trim, wire contract C1) for cross-agent session correspondence — validated at the bridge, stored and echoed by the coordinator's spawn registry (requires coordinator 0.25.0+). Consumes the dsh-plugin-task-coordinator 0.24.0 service seam (ctx.get('taskCoordinator').ops) read-only under a shared isolate label; degrades to 503 when the coordinator is absent or disabled. Defense skeleton follows the official dsh-webhook-github adapter (constant-time token compare, single-value header check, Content-Length precheck plus streaming body cap, method whitelist, non-echoing static errors, 503 fallback).

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check auth.mjs && node --check endpoints.mjs && node --check policy.mjs && node --check smoke.mjs && node --check verify-installed.mjs
